g.text: The new world and its historical requirements

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243c43

g.text: 1–5: paired-continent interiors, watersheds, basin and highlands. 6–8: ancestral refuge and continental contact cores.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243c43

g.text: 9–11: shelf cradle, shelf-human settlement and highland islanders. Markers test placement, not population viability.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536a6e

g.text: Candidate geography. Sea-level windows, drainage, climate, mountains and a consistent plate history still require reconstruction.
